body.name: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{low}}\)
body.construction: Fix the stratum masses, one smooth positive \(f_x\), and two nonidentical asymmetric error laws, imposing the location normalization only on \(U_2\). Obtain compactly supported error transforms from translated mixtures of a sufficiently high even power of a sinc density. At \(K_n\), vary only \(b_{j,n,x}\) by a normalized Christoffel--Darboux packet in the degree block from \(K_n\) through \(2K_n\), localized inside \(I\), orthogonal to lower-degree polynomials, and amplitude-calibrated to keep \(b_{j,n,x}\in[1/4,3/4]\), retain \(\varepsilon_R\) of Sobolev-radius slack, and target total variation at most \(\eta\).
